office_does: The county auditor runs elections and voter registration, records property documents, issues vehicle and marriage licenses, and keeps the county's financial records and payroll.
race_blurb: Democrat Callie Gee, a 24-year-old accountant who led the primary, faces Republican Spokane City Councilmember Michael Cathcart for the seat retiring Democrat Vicky Dalton has held since 1998; Dalton endorses Cathcart. Both pledge to protect vote-by-mail and publish county spending online.

candidates.summary: First-time Democratic candidate and public accountant who co-chairs the Spokane County Young Democrats and stresses election security and spending transparency.
highlights: Pledges independent oversight and protection of vote-by-mail, and wider election-observer training [S1][S6]
Would build a public portal tracking county spending to show where cuts could be made [S6]
Endorsed by the Spokane County Democrats, the Spokane Regional Labor Council and Commissioner Amber Waldref [S3]

experience.basis: 24-year-old first-time candidate who says the job isn't about who's been in politics the longest and stresses that she is younger than most who run.

spending.basis: Pledges fiscal responsibility and efficiency and a spending portal to find bottlenecks and possible cuts.

candidates.summary: Two-term Republican Spokane City Councilmember and former council finance chair, endorsed by retiring Auditor Vicky Dalton, who pitches himself as a budget hawk and election-transparency watchdog.
highlights: Would livestream canvassing and post-election audits and expand risk-limiting audits [S2]
Calls himself a 'budget hawk' and proposes an open-checkbook platform for county spending [S2]
Led a city charter amendment taking redistricting away from council members [S3]

experience.basis: Most senior Spokane City Councilmember, elected 2019 and 2023, former finance chair and chair of several regional boards.

spending.basis: Repeatedly frames himself as a budget hawk and financial watchdog offering fiscally conservative answers to budget shortfalls.

taxes.basis: Campaign site carries an endorser's account that he opposed major tax increases and led a ban on local income taxes in Spokane.

reform.basis: Led a charter amendment taking redistricting out of politicians' hands and presents open government as his record.
